inputs.name: fleet_version
inputs.description: Fleet release to install, such as "4.94.0". Raising it stops Fleet, runs its database migrations and starts the new release. Change fleet_sha256 with it.

inputs.name: fleet_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 of fleet_v<version>_linux.tar.gz, from the release's checksums.txt.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address Fleet listens on. Set it to "0.0.0.0" or a private address once setup is done, or hosts elsewhere can't enroll. Until setup is done, whoever reaches Fleet first can create its admin.

inputs.name: server_name
inputs.description: Name or IP address osquery and browsers use to reach Fleet. It goes in the self-signed certificate. Changing it makes a new one.

inputs.name: tls
inputs.description: Serve HTTPS. Set it to false only behind a reverse proxy that handles TLS: osquery only talks to Fleet over TLS.

inputs.name: tls_cert_file
inputs.description: Certificate already on the host, readable by the fleet user. When null, the circuit makes a self-signed one for server_name.

inputs.name: tls_key_file
inputs.description: Private key for tls_cert_file, already on the host, readable by the fleet user.

inputs.name: database_name
inputs.description: MySQL database. It must exist already.

inputs.name: database_user
inputs.description: MySQL user, with all privileges on database_name.

inputs.name: database_password
inputs.description: Password for database_user. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_database_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: redis_address
inputs.description: Redis or Valkey server as host:port.

inputs.name: redis_password
inputs.description: Password for Redis or Valkey. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_redis_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: server_private_key
inputs.description: Key Fleet encrypts the secrets it stores with, at least 32 bytes, such as the output of openssl rand -base64 32. Keep a copy: secrets encrypted with it can't be read without it. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_server_private_key; it never reaches state or the plan.
